models_evaluated: two-stage NLP system: keyword filtering followed by logistic regression

links.outcome: Median time from message receipt to crisis specialist triage before vs after deployment
links.effect: Daily median time to crisis specialist triage was 8 to 13 min after deployment, compared to 9 h before deployment.
links.quote: The daily median time from message receipt to crisis specialist triage ranges from 8 to 13 min, compared to 9 h before the deployment of the system.

links.outcome: Sensitivity and PPV for detecting crisis messages needing escalation (missed vs unnecessary flags)
links.effect: Prospective sensitivity 0.98 (95% CI 0.96-0.99) with PPV 0.66 (0.626-0.692); retrospective sensitivity 0.99 and PPV 0.35, so few missed crises but many unnecessary flags.
links.quote: In the prospective test set, the model has an AUC of 0.98 (95% CI: 0.966-0.984), sensitivity of 0.98 (95% CI: 0.96-0.99), and PPV of 0.66 (95% CI: 0.626-0.692).

screen.reason: The study deployed an NLP triage system in real telehealth operations to detect crisis messages and evaluated the operational impact on triage response time compared to pre-deployment.

primary.practice: AI-assisted crisis triage and workflow escalation
